## Decision

SAMT-BU uses GitHub, in the samt-x organisation, for content, tasks and collaboration. The choice is **provisional** and can be revisited.

## Background

GitHub has been used since the documentation work started in February 2026, without the choice having been recorded as a decision. It is recorded now because the choice is debatable from a digital sovereignty perspective, and because several pages in the documentation need a common place to refer to.

## Rationale and trade-offs

Described in full under [Platform choice: GitHub](/en/prosjektleveranser/loesninger/plattformvalg/): why GitHub, what the choice costs in terms of digital sovereignty, the alternatives, what it would take to switch, and when the choice should be revisited.
